page.overview:
Who is N'h'll?

N'h'll is a fictional entity created by Peter A. Worthy for his short story "Sweet Despise".

N'h'll is a mysterious entity or force worshiped at least by one insane killer who escaped from Arkham Asylum. Information about N'h'll is apparently only to be found in the Song of Yste. While there is almost nothing known about N'h'll, it is probably the void for all, including the Great Old Ones, and even such as Mlandoth. (: "Sweet Despise")
